review.brief:
Review RM52 tier 3 (change RM52-platform-add-monthly-capacity-cli, module platform). Read the DIFF against the merge-base with main, not the whole repo. Commits: f922fda (code + config), 486b6b0 (Makefile + docs), f7772c0 (backlog note), 8ba8fc8 (KB guide).

'platform' is a pseudo-module: cmd/monthly-capacity/, internal/config/, Makefile, README.md, cmd/README.md, internal/charging/AGENTS.md, docs/, kkpa/context/. Anything changed OUTSIDE those paths is a blocker finding.

VALIDATE:
1. Module boundary. cmd/monthly-capacity holds ZERO business logic beyond pure period/flag helpers. It calls charging.NewMonthlyCapacityCalculator as a PUBLIC port; it must not import internal/charging/db. cmd/web must still not wire the calculator.
2. Design compliance, verbatim: period.go's four functions against design.md D1-D3; main.go's flag.Visit handling of an explicit -tesla-id 0 (D1); resolvePeriod called BEFORE any config or DB touch; the output line and exit codes (D5); the make target's two optional arguments (D6); config.LoadDatabase's shape and its no-Tesla-credential rule (D7).
3. THE TEST-CONTRACT RULE, the hardest check: period_test.go and config_test.go must assert design.md's Test Contract groups A, B and C as authored BEFORE implementation - never whatever the code happens to do. Check each expected value against design.md's own table. The leader already corrected A4's expected value and replaced A5's oracle, which called the function under test; verify no other case has a self-referencing oracle.
4. previousMonth correctness. The leader fixed a bug here: it reused tier 2's day math without tier 2's day==1 gate, so it returned the wrong day on any day but the 1st. Confirm it now goes to the month start first, and that a test would catch a regression.
5. Time zone. cmd/* is exempt from the raw-time.Now ban only as design.md states; the period default must come through internal/clock. make tz-guard must stay green.
6. Docs. Every doc the new runnable makes stale is updated in-change: root README structure tree + dependency graph, cmd/README.md binaries table, cmd/monthly-capacity/README.md, internal/charging/AGENTS.md, internal/config/AGENTS.md, kkpa/context/architecture/nightly-cycle.md, and the new kkpa/context/workflows/vehicle-monthly-metrics.md + its INDEX.md rows. Flag any that is wrong or missing.
7. KB guide accuracy. vehicle-monthly-metrics.md must match the CODE, not the archived change docs. It absorbed two staged sync proposals, one of which described tier 1 only. Check its component map paths and symbol names all exist.
8. openspec/changes/archive/ must be untouched. make archive-guard enforces it.
9. Anti-gaming: no acceptance criterion weakened, no task ticked without the work, no status self-approved.

TEST SIGNALS - who ran what. Assistant-run: gofmt -l, go build ./..., go vet ./..., make tz-guard, make boundary-guard, make archive-guard - all green. USER-run and user-reported: make check passed (the full suite, including the tests in this change). Judge test QUALITY by reading the tests. Do NOT run the suite yourself.

Note for your report, not a finding to fix here: tier 1's comments in internal/charging/monthly_capacity.go and capacity.go cite decision IDs and design.md. That is out of this tier's scope and out of its granted paths. Do not edit them.
